context.hint: Require verified membership before forwarding a configured OIDC group.
context.surface: An identity adapter enriches sessions using configured group names, a user-info claim, and separate project data.
assumptions: The configured names act as a filter over verified membership.

review.invariant: A missing or empty claim grants no claim-derived groups. Project-derived membership follows its own rules.
review.verification: Check missing and empty claims and a valid project membership. Inspect downstream authorization and forwarded group headers.

source_observation.summary: Focused regressions confirmed that omitted and empty claims added no configured groups and that the project-membership path still worked.
